notes: Third-party skill packs: provenance and selection, never vendored source.

`bin/dsh skills sync` clones each pack at its pinned commit into the agent workspace, then links only the selected skill directories into ~/.agents/skills, where DeepSeek Harness discovers them (user-agents root, rank 500) and Cursor/Codex read the same tree.
The upstream clone keeps its LICENSE and history, so nothing here redistributes the skills.
Pin `commit` to the exact SHA that was reviewed, never a branch.
`include` paths are repo-relative directories that contain a SKILL.md.

Skill names must stay unique across packs and must not collide with skills shipped by profile bundles: ~/.agents/skills outranks bundled skills (rank 500 before 600), so a collision silently shadows the bundle's copy. Sync refuses duplicates instead.
Every `exclude` entry needs a reason; it is the review trail for the next update.

packs.title: Matt Pocock — Skills for Real Engineers

exclude.skills/misc: Claude Code hooks, shoehorning and exercise scaffolding; not general workflows
exclude.skills/engineering/ask-matt: router over the whole upstream repo; misroutes when the rest is not installed
exclude.skills/engineering/setup-matt-pocock-ski: one-time setup for the upstream repo's own issue tracker
exclude.skills/engineering/grill-with-docs: redirect stub that re-invokes other skills
exclude.skills/engineering/grill-me: redirect stub that re-invokes other skills

packs.title: Anthropic — Skills
packs.licenseNote: No root LICENSE file; the upstream README states the skills are open source under Apache 2.0 and are demonstration material.

exclude.skills/claude-api: excluded by request: collection-specific API guidance
exclude.skills/docx: superseded by the bundled office-docx skill
exclude.skills/pdf: superseded by the bundled office skills
exclude.skills/pptx: superseded by the bundled office-pptx skill
exclude.skills/xlsx: superseded by the bundled office-xlsx skill
exclude.skills/discernment-nudge: injects an output style into every answer

exclude.orchestrate: spawns Cursor cloud agents through the Cursor SDK
exclude.continual-learning: delegates to Cursor's own agents-memory-updater subagent
exclude.docs-canvas: renders into the Cursor docs UI
exclude.pr-review-canvas: renders into the Cursor PR review UI
exclude.pstack: 61-skill personal opinion stack; overlaps the packs above

skipped.title: obra/superpowers
skipped.reason: 13 of its 15 skill names already ship with the Aegis profile bundle (brainstorming, dispatching-parallel-agents, executing-plans, finishing-a-development-branch, receiving-code-review, requesting-code-review, subagent-driven-development, systematic-debugging, test-driven-development, using-git-worktrees, verification-before-completion, writing-plans, writing-skills). Because ~/.agents/skills outranks bundled skills, installing them here would shadow Aegis's DSH-adapted copies and break Aegis routing. The two remaining skills are not wanted either: using-superpowers competes with the Aegis routing bootstrap, diagnosing-superpowers only debugs its own installer.
skipped.revisitWhen: Aegis is dropped from the profile, or superpowers gains skills outside its current set.
